stem: What does the break between stanza 4 (lines 19–24) and stanza 5 (lines 25–30) of the poem “Leaping Falls” convey to the reader?
instruction: Use “Leaping Falls” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: A sense of suspense as the reader anticipates the effect of the spoken word

options.label: B
options.text: A sense of doubt as the reader considers whether the waterfall could be affected by the spoken word

options.label: C
options.text: A feeling of uncertainty that the speaker is telling a true story

options.label: D
options.text: A feeling of sympathy for the strong emotions the speaker reveals
